My hatred of my enemies is blind and unreasoning.
I obey the law, even if the law causes misery.
I'd rather eat my armor than admit when I'm wrong.

name: Shipwright (Ghosts of Saltmarsh)
personality_traits: I believe that anything worth doing is worth doing right. I can't help it—I'm a perfectionist.
I'm a snob who looks down on those who can't appreciate fine craftsmanship.
I always want to know how things work and what makes them tick.
I'm full of witty aphorisms and have a proverb for every occasion.
I'm rude to people who lack my commitment to hard work and fair play.
I like to talk at length about my profession.
I don't part with my money easily and will haggle tirelessly to get the best deal possible.
I'm well known for my work, and I want to make sure everyone appreciates it. I'm always taken aback when people haven't heard of me.

ideals.text: Community. It is the duty of all civilized people to strengthen the bonds of community and the security of civilization.
Generosity. My talents were given to me so that I could use them to benefit the world.
Freedom. Everyone should be free to pursue his or her own livelihood.
Greed. I'm only in it for the money.
People. I'm committed to the people I care about, not to ideals.
Aspiration. I work hard to be the best there is at my craft.

bonds: The shipyard where I learned my trade is the most important place in the world to me.
I created a great ship for someone, and then found them unworthy to captain it. I'm still looking for someone worthy.
I owe my guild a great debt for forging me into the person I am today.
I pursue wealth to secure someone's love.
One day I will return to my guild and prove that I am the greatest shipwright of them all.
I will get revenge on the evil forces that destroyed my shipyard and ruined my livelihood.
flaws: I'll do anything to get my hands on something rare or priceless.
I'm quick to assume that someone is trying to cheat me.
No one must ever learn that I once stole money from guild coffers.
I'm never satisfied with what I have—I always want more.
I would kill to acquire a noble title.
I'm horribly jealous of anyone who can outshine my handiwork. Everywhere I go, I'm surrounded by rivals.

name: Smuggler (Ghosts of Saltmarsh)
personality_traits: I always have a plan for what to do when things go wrong.
I am always calm, no matter what the situation. I never raise my voice or let my emotions control me.
I am incredibly slow to trust. Those who seem the fairest often have the most to hide.
I don't pay attention to the risks in a situation. Never tell me the odds.
The best way to get me to do something is to tell me I can't do it.
I blow up at the slightest insult.
I know a guy who knows a guy, who knows another guy.
My favorable regard for my friends and allies is the only thing that keeps me from being a total monster.

ideals.text: Honor. I don't steal from others in the trade.
Freedom. Chains are meant to be broken, as are those who would forge them.
Charity. I smuggle goods to help people in need.
Greed. I will do whatever it takes to become wealthy.
People. I'm loyal to my friends, not to any ideals, and everyone else can take a trip down the Styx for all I care.
Redemption. There's a spark of good in everyone.

bonds: I'm trying to pay off an old debt I owe to a generous benefactor.
My ill-gotten gains go to support my family.
Something important was taken from me, and I aim to steal it back.
I will become the greatest smuggler that ever lived.
I'm guilty of a terrible crime. I hope I can redeem myself for it.
Someone I loved died because of a mistake I made. That will never happen again.
flaws: When I see something valuable, I can't think about anything but how to steal it.
When faced with a choice between money and my friends, I usually choose the money.
If there's a plan, I'll forget it. If I don't forget it, I'll ignore it.
I have a "tell" that reveals when I'm lying.
I turn tail and run when things look bad.
An innocent person is in prison for a crime that I committed. I'm okay with that.

name: Anthropologist (Tomb of Annihilation)
personality_traits: I prefer the company of those who aren't like me, including people of other races.
I'm a stickler when it comes to observing proper etiquette and local customs.
I would rather observe than meddle.
By living among violent people, I have become desensitized to violence.
I would risk life and limb to discover a new culture or unravel the secrets of a dead one.
When I arrive at a new settlement for the first time, I must learn all its customs.

ideals.text: Discovery. I want to be the first person to discover a lost culture.
Distance. One must not interfere with the affairs of another culture—even one in need of aid.
Knowledge. By understanding other races and cultures, we learn to understand ourselves.
Power. Common people crave strong leadership, and I do my utmost to provide it.
Protection. I must do everything possible to save a society facing extinction.
Indifferent. Life is cruel. What's the point in saving people if they're going to die anyway?

bonds: My mentor gave me a journal filled with lore and wisdom. Losing it would devastate me.
Having lived among the people of a primeval tribe or clan, I long to return and see how they are faring.
Years ago, tragedy struck the members of an isolated society I befriended, and I will honor them.
I want to learn more about a particular humanoid culture that fascinates me.
I seek to avenge a clan, tribe, kingdom, or empire that was wiped out.
I have a trinket that I believe is the key to finding a long-lost society.
flaws: Boats make me seasick.
I talk to myself, and I don't make friends easily.
I believe that I'm intellectually superior to people from other cultures and have much to teach them.
I've picked up some unpleasant habits living among goblins, lizardfolk, or orcs.
I complain about everything.
I wear a tribal mask and never take it off.

name: Archaeologist (Tomb of Annihilation)
personality_traits: I love a good puzzle or mystery.
I'm a pack rat who never throws anything away.
Fame is more important to me than money.
I have no qualms about stealing from the dead.
I'm happier in a dusty old tomb than in the centers of civilization.
Traps don't make me nervous. Idiots who trigger traps make me nervous.
I might fail, but I will never give up.
You might think I'm a scholar, but I love a good brawl. These fists were made for punching.

ideals.text: Preservation. That artifact belongs in a museum.
Greed. I won't risk my life for nothing. I expect some kind of payment.
Death Wish. Nothing is more exhilarating than a narrow escape from the jaws of death.
Dignity. The dead and their belongings deserve to be treated with respect.
Immortality. All my exploring is part of a plan to find the secret of everlasting life.
Danger. With every great discovery comes grave danger. The two walk hand in hand.

bonds: Ever since I was a child, I've heard stories about a lost city. I aim to find it, learn its secrets, and earn my place in the history books.
I want to find my mentor, who disappeared on an expedition some time ago.
I have a friendly rival. Only one of us can be the best, and I aim to prove it's me.
I won't sell an art object or other treasure that has historical significance or is one of a kind.
I'm secretly in love with the wealthy patron who sponsors my archaeological exploits.
I hope to bring prestige to a library, a museum, or a university.
flaws: I have a secret fear of some common wild animal—and in my work, I see them everywhere.
I can't leave a room without searching it for secret doors.
When I'm not exploring dungeons or ruins, I get jittery and impatient.
I have no time for friends or family. I spend every waking moment thinking about and preparing for my next expedition.
When given the choice of going left or right, I always go left.
I can't sleep except in total darkness.

name: Athlete
personality_traits: I feel most at peace during physical exertion, be it exercise or battle.
I don't like to sit idle.
I have a daily exercise routine that I refuse to break.
Obstacles exist to be overcome.
When I see others struggling, I offer to help.
I love to trade banter and gibes.
Anything worth doing is worth doing best.
I get irritated if people praise someone else and not me.

ideals.text: Competition. I strive to test myself in all things.
Triumph. The best part of winning is seeing my rivals brought low.
Camaraderie. The strongest bonds are forged through struggle.
People. I strive to inspire my spectators.
Tradition. Every game has rules, and the playing field must be level.
Growth. Lessons hide in victory and defeat.

bonds: My teammates are my family.
I will overcome a rival and prove myself their better.
My mistake got someone hurt. I'll never make that mistake again.
I will be the best for the honor and glory of my home.
The person who trained me is the most important person in my world.
I strive to live up to a specific hero's example.
flaws: I am a poor winner. I gloat.
I am a sore loser. I sulk.
I push myself too hard and risk injury.
I am envious of anyone more skilled than I am.
I have a short temper when things go wrong.
I am dismissive of those who cannot match my physical prowess.

name: Azorius Functionary
personality_traits: I try never to let my judgment become clouded by emotion.
I have infinite patience with the dolts and boors I'm forced to deal with every day.
When I give an order, I expect it to be obeyed.
I just want things the way I like them: neat, orderly, and clean.
No wrongdoing can escape my watchful gaze.
I always say exactly what I mean, no matter how many words it takes to communicate the particular nuance I am attempting to convey.
I'm very literal and don't appreciate metaphor or sarcasm.
I never change my mind once it's made up.

ideals.text: Guild. My guild is all that really matters.
Order. The law is meant to ensure that the gears of society turn smoothly and quietly.
Peace. The ultimate object of the law is to remove violence from society.
Compliance. Coercion is a fine way of ensuring that the laws are obeyed.
Legislation. The law embodies excellence in its precision and detail.
Punishment. A public display of consequences is an excellent deterrent for other criminals.

bonds: I am beholden to an Azorius arrester who captured the criminal who killed my parents, saving me from the same fate.
I hope one day to write the laws, not just enforce them.
I tried and failed to prevent a murder, and I have sworn to find and arrest the perpetrator.
I successfully prevented a murder, and the would-be perpetrator wants me dead.
One of my parents was prominent in the guild, and I resent constantly being compared to that standard.
I've modeled my career after a highly respected law-mage or arrester, but I fear that my role model might be involved in something illegal.
flaws: I'm unable to distinguish between the letter and the spirit of the law.
I seem like a harsh judge to others, but I am even harsher on myself.
I am rigid and inflexible in my thinking.
I believe that the law is the only thing standing between civilization and chaos, and I will do anything to uphold it.
I am suspicious of anyone who does not respect the law.
I am blind to the flaws in the legal system I serve.

name: Black Fist Double Agent
personality_traits: People are only as trustworthy as you are valuable to them. Always strive to be the most valuable person around.
My eloquence and sophistication are tools I use to avoid arousing suspicion myself.
I am a thrill-seeker, excited by covert and dangerous missions.
I live by my wits and always check every lock twice.
I never admit to my mistakes lest they be used against me.
I take pride in my work, no matter which side I'm working for.
I am always calm and collected, even when things go wrong.
I am a master of disguise and misdirection.

ideals.text: Secrecy. I must keep my true loyalties hidden.
Survival. I do whatever it takes to stay alive.
Freedom. I work to free Phlan from its oppressors.
Power. I seek to gain influence and control.
Loyalty. I am loyal to the Black Fists, even if I must pretend otherwise.
Redemption. I hope to atone for my past misdeeds.

bonds: I have a reliable contact within the Tears of Virulence garrison to whom I pass information.
My Black Fists contacts can help me secure an audience with important figures.
I owe a debt to the person who helped me become a double agent.
I will do anything to protect the people of Phlan.
I seek to expose the corruption of the Tears of Virulence.
I have a family member who is a member of the Black Fists.
flaws: I am paranoid and trust no one.
I am greedy and will do anything for money.
I am quick to anger and prone to violence.
I am a compulsive liar.
I am afraid of being discovered and will betray anyone to save myself.
I secretly admire the Tears of Virulence and their methods.

name: Boros Legionnaire
personality_traits: I see everything in clear-cut black and white.
I'm just a little fascinated by the ways of the Gruul.
I'm slow to trust members of other guilds.
I've been known to turn a blind eye to injustice, with the help of a modest bribe.
I approach every task with the same high degree of military precision.
I am always the first to volunteer for dangerous missions.
I believe that the ends justify the means when it comes to justice.
I am fiercely loyal to my fellow legionnaires.

ideals.text: Guild. My guild is all that really matters.
Justice. The law is the tool of justice, and I am its instrument.
Peace. The ultimate goal of the legion is to establish peace on the streets of Ravnica.
Might. The strong must rule, and the weak must obey.
Order. Without order, there is only chaos.
Zeal. I am a true believer in the Boros Legion and its cause.

bonds: I owe my life to the Boros captain who took me in when I was living on the streets.
My fellow legionnaires are my family.
I wield the same Boros weapon my grandparent did, for the honor of our family.
I am determined to bring a notorious criminal to justice.
I will prove myself worthy of the angelic leadership of the Boros Legion.
I fight for those who cannot fight for themselves.
flaws: I am inflexible in my beliefs.
I am quick to judge others.
I am reckless and put myself in danger unnecessarily.
I have a hard time trusting anyone outside the legion.
I am haunted by a past failure.
I am blind to the flaws of my superiors.

name: Caravan Specialist
personality_traits: Any group is only as strong as its weakest link. Everyone has to pull their own weight.
There's always someone out there trying to take what I've got. Always be vigilant.
I have a story for every road and a song for every town.
I'm always the first to wake and the last to sleep.
I can find common ground with anyone, from the lowliest laborer to the highest lord.
I hate to be cooped up indoors.
I am always prepared for the worst.
I love the open road and the freedom it brings.

ideals.text: Service. Using my talents to help others is the best way of helping myself.
Selfish. What people don't know WILL hurt them, but why is that my problem?
Wanderer. I go where the road takes me. Sometimes, that's a good thing...
Community. The caravan is my family, and I will protect it.
Freedom. The open road is the only place I truly feel free.
Survival. The road is dangerous, and only the prepared survive.

bonds: I owe a debt I can never repay to the person who took pity on me.
My caravan is my family.
I am searching for a lost caravan that disappeared on the road.
I will do anything to protect my cargo.
I have a map that leads to a legendary treasure.
I am loyal to the merchant who employs me.
flaws: I have trouble trusting people I've just met.
I enjoy the open road. Underground and tight spaces make me very nervous.
I am greedy and always looking for a better deal.
I am quick to abandon a losing proposition.
I am suspicious of strangers.
I am afraid of commitment and always keep moving.

name: Cormanthor Refugee
personality_traits: I long for a home that never really existed, whether in the camps, Hillsfar, or Myth Drannor.
Though I am not an elf, I am a fervent, radical worshipper of the elven gods.
I live in the moment, for the past is gone and the future is uncertain.
I believe the gods have cursed me, my family, and all of the Cormanthor refugees. We are all doomed.
I am fiercely independent and refuse to rely on anyone else.
I am deeply suspicious of anyone who offers help.
I will do anything to protect my fellow refugees.
I am always looking for a way to reclaim my lost homeland.

ideals.text: Patient. The elves have taught me to think and plan for the long-term.
Hope. One day, we will return to our homeland and rebuild.
Freedom. I will never be enslaved again.
Vengeance. I will make those who drove us from our homes pay.
Community. We must stick together to survive.
Survival. Nothing matters more than staying alive.

bonds: I am loyal to the other refugees from my village.
I carry a memento of my lost home.
I seek to find a safe haven for my people.
I owe my life to the elf who rescued me.
I will not rest until my homeland is restored.
I protect those who cannot protect themselves.
flaws: I am very uncomfortable indoors and underground.
I am haughty.
I am paranoid and see threats everywhere.
I am bitter and resentful of those who still have homes.
I am reckless and willing to die for my cause.
I am slow to trust anyone who is not a refugee.

name: Dimir Operative
personality_traits: I'm good at hiding my true thoughts and feelings.
When I'm in doubt about revealing something, I assume it's a secret, and I don't share it.
I'm always watching, listening, and gathering information.
I have a dry, sardonic sense of humor.
I am a master of deception and misdirection.
I trust no one completely.
I am always several steps ahead of everyone else.
I am patient and willing to wait for the right moment.

ideals.text: Guild. My guild is all that really matters.
Control. I like pulling the strings.
Secrets. I collect secrets and never reveal them.
Knowledge. I want to know as much as I can about this city and how it works.
Freedom. Information is power, and I will use it to be free.
Power. I will do whatever it takes to gain power.

bonds: I have a contact in every guild.
I am loyal to House Dimir and its goals.
I have a secret that could destroy a powerful person.
I owe a debt to the Dimir operative who trained me.
I am searching for a legendary secret.
I will do anything to protect my true identity.
flaws: I am paranoid and trust no one.
I am arrogant and believe I am smarter than everyone else.
I am ruthless and will sacrifice anyone for the mission.
I am addicted to secrets and cannot resist learning them.
I am detached and have trouble forming genuine relationships.
I have a secret that could get me killed if it is discovered.

name: Dragon Casualty
personality_traits: I am driven to escape my past, and rarely stay in one place long.
I know secrets of the Maimed Virulence, but fear the harm that may befall me should others learn them.
I am slow to trust, but incredibly loyal to those who have earned it.
I am haunted by the horrors I witnessed.
I am determined to rebuild my life.
I am suspicious of anyone who offers help.
I am always looking over my shoulder.
I will do anything to protect other survivors.

ideals.text: Survival. I will do whatever it takes to stay alive.
Independence. I rely only on myself.
Compassion. I help those who have suffered as I have.
Vengeance. I will make the Maimed Virulence pay.
Secrecy. My secrets must never be revealed.
Hope. I believe that a better future is possible.

bonds: I have sworn vengeance on the Maimed Virulence and those that follow him.
I protect my fellow survivors.
I carry a memento of my former life.
I owe my life to the person who rescued me.
I will not rest until I have rebuilt my home.
I seek to uncover the secrets of the Maimed Virulence.
flaws: I am paranoid and overly suspicious of others.
I am haunted by nightmares.
I am quick to anger.
I am afraid of dragons and will flee from them.
I am secretive and refuse to share information.
I am reckless and have little regard for my own safety.

name: Earthspur Miner
personality_traits: Nothing bothers me for long.
I hate the horrors of the Underdark with a passion. They took my friends and family and almost got me.
I can party with everyone. Whether with dwarves or anyone else, I'll join in.
I'd rather be mining. This is okay, but it's not the same.
I am always looking for new mineral deposits.
I am suspicious of magic and those who use it.
I am fiercely loyal to my fellow miners.
I am always prepared for a cave-in or other disaster.

ideals.text: Generosity. The riches of the earth are to be shared by all.
Greed. Gems and precious metals, I want them all for myself.
Community. The people of the Earthspur mines are my family. I will do anything to protect them.
Tradition. The old ways of mining must be preserved.
Freedom. I go where the ore takes me.
Survival. The mines are dangerous, and only the careful survive.

bonds: The people of the Earthspur mines are my family. I will do anything to protect them.
A deep gnome saved my life when I was injured and alone.
I am searching for a legendary vein of ore.
I owe a debt to the miner who taught me everything I know.
I will do anything to protect my mining claim.
I seek to uncover the secrets of the Underdark.
flaws: I am greedy and will do anything for wealth.
I am suspicious of outsiders.
I am claustrophobic in wide-open spaces.
I am quick to anger.
I am superstitious.
I am afraid of the dark.

name: Faceless
personality_traits: I'm earnest and uncommonly direct.
I strive to have no personality—it's easier to forget what's hardly there.
I treasure a memento from my true self.
I think far ahead, a detachedness often mistaken for daydreaming.
I am ever learning how to be among others—when to stay quiet, when to laugh.
I am always watching and learning.
I am a master of disguise.
I have trouble telling who I really am.

ideals.text: Justice. I will see justice done, no matter the cost.
Confusion. Deception is a weapon.
Freedom. I will be free to be who I truly am.
Power. I will use my disguises to gain power.
Identity. I will discover my true self.
Community. I will find a place where I belong.

bonds: I am exceptional.
I have a secret that I must protect.
I am searching for my true family.
I owe a debt to the person who gave me my first disguise.
I will do anything to protect my true identity.
I am loyal to those who accept me for who I am.
flaws: I have trouble distinguishing dreams from memories.
I am indecisive.
I am detached and have trouble forming genuine relationships.
I am paranoid and trust no one.
I am afraid of being discovered.
I have no sense of my own identity.

name: Failed Merchant
personality_traits: I didn't have the cutthroat attitude necessary to succeed. I won't make that mistake again.
Even my competitors said I was affable and talented. Those are the qualities I have to overcome.
When I get an idea, I am single-minded in its execution.
My heart wasn't in being a merchant, so I failed.
I am always looking for a new opportunity.
I am determined to prove that I can succeed.
I am suspicious of anyone who offers a deal.
I am always prepared for the worst.

ideals.text: Survival. I will do whatever it takes to stay alive.
Ambition. I will rise to the top, no matter what it takes.
Honesty. I will not lie or cheat, even if it costs me.
Freedom. I will be my own boss.
Wealth. I will become rich, no matter what.
Community. I help my friends and neighbors.

bonds: I am determined to pay off my debts.
I have a family member in need. I consider them in everything I do.
I owe a debt to the person who gave me a second chance.
I am searching for a lost shipment.
I will not rest until I have restored my reputation.
I protect my former employees.
flaws: I am greedy and will do anything for money.
I am reckless and take unnecessary risks.
I am suspicious of strangers.
I am quick to anger.
I am afraid of failure.
I am overconfident and underestimate my opponents.

name: Feylost
personality_traits: I'm haunted by fey laughter that only I can hear, though I know it's just my mind playing tricks on me.
Like a nomad, I can't settle down in one place for very long.
I frequently lose track of time.
I speak to animals and plants as though they might answer.
I delight in riddles, songs, and strange stories.
I find it difficult to distinguish dreams from memories.
I am always looking for a way back to the Feywild.
I am fascinated by the strange and the unknown.

ideals.text: Friendship. I never leave a friend behind.
Empathy. No creature should be made to suffer.
Wanderlust. I prefer to take the less traveled path.
Wonder. The world is full of magic and mystery.
Freedom. I will not be bound by the rules of the mortal world.
Knowledge. I seek to understand the ways of the fey.

bonds: I am searching for a way back to the Feywild.
I have a fey companion who is always with me.
I owe a debt to a fey creature who helped me escape.
I carry a token from the Feywild.
I will do anything to protect my fellow Feylost.
I am trying to remember my true family.
flaws: I find it difficult to distinguish dreams from memories.
I am easily distracted.
I have trouble understanding mortal customs.
I am reckless and have little regard for my own safety.
I am afraid of iron and other cold-wrought metals.
I am drawn to the Feywild and will do almost anything to return.

name: Gambler
personality_traits: I always have a plan for what to do when things go wrong.
I am always calm, no matter what the situation. I never raise my voice or let my emotions control me.
I am incredibly slow to trust. Those who seem the fairest often have the most to hide.
I don't pay attention to the risks in a situation. Never tell me the odds.
The best way to get me to do something is to tell me I can't do it.
I blow up at the slightest insult.
I know a guy who knows a guy, who knows another guy.
My favorable regard for my friends and allies is the only thing that keeps me from being a total monster.

ideals.text: Honor. I only cheat when the mark deserves it.
Freedom. Chains are meant to be broken, as are those who would forge them.
Charity. I steal from the wealthy so that I can help people in need.
Greed. I will do whatever it takes to become wealthy.
People. I'm loyal to my friends, not to any ideals, and everyone else can take a trip down the Styx for all I care.
Redemption. There's a spark of good in everyone.

bonds: I'm trying to pay off an old debt I owe to a generous benefactor.
My ill-gotten gains go to support my family.
Something important was taken from me, and I aim to steal it back.
I will become the greatest gambler that ever lived.
I'm guilty of a terrible crime. I hope I can redeem myself for it.
Someone I loved died because of a mistake I made. That will never happen again.
flaws: When I see something valuable, I can't think about anything but how to steal it.
When faced with a choice between money and my friends, I usually choose the money.
If there's a plan, I'll forget it. If I don't forget it, I'll ignore it.
I have a "tell" that reveals when I'm lying.
I turn tail and run when things look bad.
An innocent person is in prison for a crime that I committed. I'm okay with that.

name: Gate Urchin
personality_traits: I appreciate the simple things in life: a song, a warm meal, a sunny day. I don't need any more.
My problems are always caused by others. I'm never to blame.
I am afraid I could wind up back on the streets any day.
I see people as marks for a con and have difficulty feeling true empathy for them.
I have a real flair for matchmaking. I can find anyone a spouse!
I think money is the true measure of appreciation and affection. Everything else is talk or an act.
I don't like having a lot of stuff, just a few simple things I need. I don't like being tied down and tend to leave things behind when I don't need them anymore.
I am always looking for a way to make a quick coin.

ideals.text: Loyal. I never rat out any of my friends, even when the Red Plumes or the Rogues' Guild ask.
Ungrateful. Those who give only do it to make themselves feel better. I steal from them.
Freedom. I will not be bound by anyone.
Community. The other urchins are my family.
Survival. I do whatever it takes to stay alive.
Hope. One day, I will escape the streets.

bonds: I am loyal to the other urchins of the Gate.
I owe a debt to the person who took me in.
I am searching for a way to escape the streets.
I carry a memento of my parents.
I will do anything to protect my friends.
I dream of a better life.
flaws: I am greedy and will do anything for money.
I am suspicious of anyone who offers help.
I am quick to anger.
I am afraid of being abandoned.
I have trouble trusting anyone.
I am reckless and have little regard for my own safety.

name: Gate Warden
personality_traits: Strange events and otherworldly creatures don't phase me.
I think in terms of exchange; something for something, nothing for nothing.
I pepper my speech with borrowed words or curses from planar languages.
I have a superstitious habit I picked up, such as touching iron when I'm nervous or arranging objects in a specific order.
I've seen enough to know that you can't take anyone at face value, so I scrutinize everyone I deal with.
I am always looking for a way to gain an advantage.

ideals.text: Exchange. Everything has a price.
Knowledge. I seek to understand the multiverse.
Power. I will gain power, no matter the cost.
Community. I protect my fellow Gate Wardens.
Freedom. I will not be bound by any power.
Order. The multiverse must be kept in balance.

bonds: I am loyal to the community that raised me.
I carry a token from my home plane.
I am searching for a way to return home.
I owe a debt to a planar creature.
I will do anything to protect the gate I guard.
I seek to uncover the secrets of the planes.
flaws: I am paranoid and trust no one.
I am greedy and will do anything for money.
I am superstitious and see omens everywhere.
I am afraid of the unknown.
I am quick to anger.
I am detached and have trouble forming genuine relationships.

name: Giant Foundling
personality_traits: What I lack in stature, I make up for with sheer spite.
Sometimes size does matter, okay? If I see a beast bigger than me, I'm immediately running away.
Crowded spaces make me uncomfortable. I'd much rather be in an open field than a bustling tavern.
I like being small. It helps me avoid notice.
Size is just half the story. Every avalanche begins as a single pebble.
The world always feels too big, and I'm afraid I'll never find my place in it.
I insist on being taken seriously as a full-grown adult. Nobody talks down to me!
I am always looking for a way to prove myself.

ideals.text: Belonging. All creatures have a place in the world, so I strive to help others find theirs.
Survival. I will do whatever it takes to stay alive.
Strength. The strong survive, and the weak perish.
Community. My giant family is my family, and I will protect them.
Freedom. I will not be bound by anyone.
Destiny. I am destined for great things.

bonds: I ache to return to my tribe and the family I left.
I carry a memento from my giant family.
I owe a debt to the giant who raised me.
I am searching for my true parents.
I will do anything to protect my giant family.
I seek to prove myself worthy of my giant heritage.
flaws: I am insecure about my size.
I am quick to anger when someone underestimates me.
I am afraid of being abandoned.
I am reckless and have little regard for my own safety.
I am suspicious of anyone who offers help.
I am stubborn and refuse to admit when I am wrong.

name: Golgari Agent
personality_traits: Remember, I could kill you in your sleep. Or put centipedes in your bedroll.
I like to remind people of their inevitable demise.
I have accepted my death. Hence, I don't fear it.
I am relentless and determined in my action.
I find beauty in decay and rebirth.
I am patient and willing to wait for the right moment.
I am always looking for a way to gain an advantage.
I am fiercely loyal to my guild.

ideals.text: Guild. My guild is all that really matters.
Stoicism. All of us are part of the cyclical march of nature, which will continue with or without us.
Ambition. The time of Golgari ascendance is at hand, and I intend to have a prominent place in the new world order.
Nature. The natural world is more important than civilization.
Community. We must work together to survive.
Freedom. I will not be bound by the laws of the surface world.

bonds: I cherish the finger of a family member who was petrified by a medusa.
I am determined to rise in the ranks of the Golgari.
I owe a debt to the Golgari agent who recruited me.
I am searching for a legendary fungus.
I will do anything to protect my fellow Golgari.
I seek to uncover the secrets of the undercity.
flaws: I am morbid and obsessed with death.
I am ruthless and will sacrifice anyone for the guild.
I am paranoid and trust no one.
I am slow to trust members of other guilds.
I am afraid of fire.
I am overconfident and underestimate my opponents.

name: Grinner
personality_traits: I love the spotlight. Everyone, look at me!
Give me a drink and I'm your friend.
Talk to me about yourself. I'm a hell of a listener.
I hate to start fights, but I love to finish them.
I can't sit still.
I'm always humming an old tune from my past.
I'm a master of disguise and misdirection.
I am always looking for a way to undermine authority.

ideals.text: Self-Determination. I will decide my own fate.
Revolution. Tyrants must fall.
Freedom. I will not be bound by anyone.
Community. My fellow Grinners are my family.
Hope. I believe a better world is possible.
Secrecy. My true identity must remain hidden.

bonds: I am loyal to the Golden Grin and its goals.
I owe a debt to the Grinner who recruited me.
I carry a memento of my past.
I am searching for a way to free my homeland.
I will do anything to protect my fellow Grinners.
I seek to expose the corruption of the powerful.
flaws: I've never lied once in my life. What?
I am reckless and have little regard for my own safety.
I am a compulsive liar.
I am quick to anger.
I am afraid of being discovered.
I am overconfident and underestimate my opponents.

name: Gruul Anarch
personality_traits: Unlike people, the beasts of the wild are friends who won't stab me in the back.
Go ahead and insult me - I dare you.
I scorn those who are weak and cling to civilization.
I am determined that one day I will lead my clan - or a new one.
If you question my courage, I will never back down.
I am always looking for a fight.
I am fiercely independent and refuse to rely on anyone else.
I am always looking for a way to destroy civilization.

ideals.text: Clan. My clan is all that really matters.
Anarchy. No person or law or custom can tell another what to do.
Tradition. The Old Ways must be preserved and upheld.
Strength. The strong survive, and the weak perish.
Nature. The natural world is more important than civilization.
Freedom. I will not be bound by anyone.

bonds: I am determined that one day I will lead my clan - or a new one.
My clan is my family.
I owe a debt to the Gruul anarch who saved my life.
I am searching for a legendary beast.
I will do anything to protect my clan.
I seek to destroy the civilization that has encroached on my territory.
flaws: I am reckless and have little regard for my own safety.
I am quick to anger.
I am suspicious of anyone who offers help.
I am stubborn and refuse to admit when I am wrong.
I am afraid of being weak.
I am overconfident and underestimate my opponents.

name: Harborfolk
personality_traits: I am curious. I want to know why things are the way they are and why people do the things that they do.
I can't sing, but that never stops me from doing it, loudly. Everyone loves a good sea chanty!
I am quite superstitious.
I am always looking for a way to make a quick coin.
I am fiercely loyal to my fellow harborfolk.
I am always ready for a fight.
I am suspicious of outsiders.
I am always looking for a way to escape the harbor.

ideals.text: Calm. For all things, there is a tide. I set sail when it is right, and mend my nets when it is not.
Windblown. I go where the winds blow. No man or woman tells me where or when to sail.
Salty. I want people to look to me as an expert on plying Mulmaster Harbor.
Selfless. We are all children of the sea. I help everyone in peril afloat and ashore.
Let them Drown. I refuse to risk my hide to help others. They wouldn't help me if roles were reversed.
Survival. I do whatever it takes to stay alive.

bonds: I once lost everything but my rowboat. I'll do anything to protect it.
